prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Monday October 5, 2026. Topic: Company news: industrial, aerospace, defense, autos/EV and transport.

Window: Friday October 2, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET) through Monday October 5, 2026 12:20 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. This spans 2 non-trading day(s): news published on those days (e.g. Saturday and Sunday) is in scope and often the most important. Anything published after 12:20 ET on Monday October 5, 2026 is out of scope.

FIND
Every material company-specific news item for US-listed industrial, aerospace, defense, autos/EV and transport companies >= $1B in the window, as many as you can find: press releases, 8-K filings, executive changes, activist campaigns, legal settlements, contracts, product launches, guidance, analyst rating/PT changes (firm, old → new), and the stock move. One bullet per company.

Run multiple searches with different phrasings and dates. Prefer primary sources and wire services
(Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's, Investopedia, company press releases, SEC
EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Census/Fed releases, FDA). For every item give the latest status as of the cutoff.

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar /
Pharma / Energy / Retail, or a concise sector name. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.

## **TSLA** — Autos/EV
- Tesla reported **486,532 third-quarter deliveries**, versus **461,100** expected by FactSet-polled analysts; shares rose **5%** on October 2. (CNBC, Oct. 2, 2026; publish time not shown)

## **RIVN** — Autos/EV
- Rivian reported **third-quarter production of 19,751 vehicles** and **deliveries of 19,248 vehicles**, and reaffirmed **2026 delivery guidance of 65,000–70,000 vehicles**; its third-quarter financial results are scheduled for **October 29, 2026**. (StockTitan, Oct. 2, 2026; publish time not shown)

## **ARXS** — Aerospace/Defense/Industrial
- RBC upgraded Arxis to **Outperform** from its prior rating; analyst **Ken Herbert** cited the company’s aerospace, defense and industrial-component exposure, and shares rose **4%**. (CNBC, Oct. 2, 2026; publish time not shown)

## **BA / NOC** — Aerospace/Defense
- The U.S. Navy selected **Boeing** over **Northrop Grumman** for the **FA-XX sixth-generation carrier-capable combat aircraft** program. (Defense & Aerospace Report, Oct. 4, 2026; publish time not shown)

## **BA** — Aerospace/Defense
- The U.S. Air Force awarded Boeing a **$2.4 billion** contract for **22 F-15EX Eagle II fighters**. (Defense & Aerospace Report, Oct. 4, 2026; publish time not shown)

## **RTX** — Aerospace/Defense
- The U.S. government awarded Raytheon **$20.7 billion** to increase annual production of **AIM-120 air-to-air missiles to 1,900**. (Defense & Aerospace Report, Oct. 4, 2026; publish time not shown)

## **HON** — Autos/EV
- Honda said it developed wireless-charging technology for electric vehicles, including large trucks, while driving and plans to test it on a Japanese highway. (Reuters, Oct. 5, 2026, 02:21 ET)

## **AIR.PA** — Aerospace
- Airbus delivered approximately **72 aircraft in September**, compared with **73** in September 2025, according to industry sources; Airbus’s informal full-year delivery target remains approximately **870 aircraft**, defined as **850–890**. (Reuters, Oct. 5, 2026; publish time not shown)

## **VOWG.DE / European autos** — Autos/EV
- Electric-vehicle sales in the European Union reached **1.64 million** during January–August 2026, up **45% year over year**, with EVs representing **22%** of the market; Volkswagen was cited as rolling out lower-priced models including an all-electric Polo. (Reuters, Oct. 5, 2026, 01:21 ET)

## **Chinese EV imports / UK autos** — Autos/EV
- The United Kingdom was reported to be preparing potential tariffs on Chinese electric-car imports, with a proposed rate that could match the European Union’s **45%** levy; Reuters said it could not independently verify the report. **[rumor] [report]** (Reuters, Oct. 4, 2026, 17:21 ET)
